purpose: Provide a primary action and a fallback for a fragile operation.
policy: PASS iff {action, params, fallback_action, fallback_params} with non-empty action/fallback_action strings and dict params.
grading_logic: action and fallback_action are non-empty strings; params and fallback_params are dicts.
known_limitations: Capability test: structure-only grading (no semantic verification of the reasoning/calculation prose beyond the checked fields).
